description: This file defines the Object API for netlink objects, including macros, structures, and function pointers for object management such as creation, cloning, dumping, and comparison.

methods.name: nl_object_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a new netlink object based on provided object operations.

methods.name: nl_object_put
methods.description: Decrements reference count and frees the object if no longer used.

methods.name: nl_object_priv
methods.description: Retrieves private data of a netlink object.

methods.name: nl_dump
methods.description: Dumps object data according to specified parameters.

methods.name: nl_new_line
methods.description: Prefixes a new line in dump output.
